doc.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Alfred Laine Interview, 1951-04-21

title: Size of marching and dance bands, and what counts as a jazz band
summary: Marching bands ran 12-18 men; dance bands were six or seven pieces, and a jazz band was typically seven; violins were dropped for wind instruments before the war.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
